# Post-Synthesis Netlist

This directory contains the gate-level representation of the 4-bit down-counter design.

## 📄 Files
* **`CNTR.v`**: A Verilog netlist generated by Mentor Graphics Precision RTL. Unlike high-level RTL code, this file describes the design using specific hardware primitives (e.g., LUTs, Flip-Flops) that the Vivado tool can map onto the FPGA fabric.

## ⚙️ Purpose
In a professional FPGA flow, the netlist serves as the bridge between logic design and physical implementation. This file is the primary input for the Place & Route (PnR) stage in Vivado.
